item_short_desc: Rothco's USMC Travel Cup is the perfect on-the-go coffee cup that shows your support for the United States Marine Corps.
description: Rothco's USMC Travel Cup is the perfect on-the-go cup that shows your support for the United States Marine Corps. The Travel Mug holds 16 fluid ounce and has a double-walled, stainless steel insulation to help keep drinks hot and fresh. A full-color USMC seal is printed on the front of the cup. The cap conveniently screws off and has a flip top for easy drinking. Rothco's Marine Corps travel mug measures 6.75" height and 3.5" diameter at widest point. Perfect for in the car or at the office.
